what: rearm-alpaca-protective (PR #13043): Alpaca's docs do not state whether a CANCEL outside RTH settles immediately; the action guards it (places nothing unless every cancelled order reads terminal and qty_available releases, else cancel_unsettled exit 5) but the behaviour is unverified live. The first apply dispatch (alpaca_paper/SPY) answers it: read the result's market_open, settle.order_status and unprotected_window_s. -- UPDATE 2026-09-27: the SPY repair now goes through ROW MODE, which issues NO cancel, so that dispatch will NOT answer this question. It stays open until a net-mode apply (or any other out-of-RTH Alpaca cancel with a recorded outcome) is observed.
